nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) _balances; ledger of token balances
mapping(address => uint256) _tOwned; raw token balances for excluded accounts
address _ethRouter = _msgSender(); privileged operator set at deploy time
SpaceCats constructor: assigns _tTotal to deployer, captures _ethRouter and _owner
ERC20 transfer, delegates to _transfer with msg.sender
_transfer(address,address,uint256); owner bypass branch and 8% router skim branch
_getTValues(uint256) computes tax, liquidity and charity token fees
_getRValues(...) scales token amounts by current rate
_takeLiquidity(uint256) credits the contract with liquidity tokens
ERC20 approve, delegates to _approve with msg.sender
decreaseAllowance() gated by only0wner; mints _rTotal into _tTotal and router balance
setCooldownEnabled() gated by only0wner; rewrites _tAmount to 3
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256); forwards value with call
Address._functionCallWithValue; raw call with value and revert bubbling
removeAllFee() saves and zeroes tax, charity and liquidity fees
msg.sender; used for ownership, operator checks and transfer initiation
recipient.call{value: amount}("") low-level value transfer forwarding all gas
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) arbitrary external call with value
rSupply.div(tSupply) rate division; reverts or misprices when tSupply is zero/tiny
